meta.title: ConstructPro — Construction Platform Backend Specification
meta.generatedFor: ConstructionProFE frontend mock data → real backend
meta.scope: All construction / project / site / BOQ / store / bidding / HR / site-mobile modules
meta.excluded: ERP module (NetLedgers) — already has backend at /transactions, /ledgers, /costcenters, etc.
notes: Unify project IDs: frontend uses P-001 (project-management) AND tower-a (BOQ). Add projects.legacyBoqSlug and map both to one row.
Cost centers in ERP should map 1:1 to projects via projects.erpCostCenterId for job-mileage / job-cost-matrix reports.
Material issuance posts to ERP inventory separately (future integration); this API owns project/site/BOQ context.
All monetary amounts: decimal(18,4). All dates: ISO-8601 UTC. IDs: string (UUID or business code per table).

erpIntegration.description: Read-only links — ERP owns accounting; construction platform owns project operational data

mappings.purpose: Job cost matrix columns = projects; cost categories = project cost breakdown
CIV-01, STR-01 etc. map to ERP cost categories under project cost center
Stock issue / construction invoice material lines
ConstructionSales voucher created in ERP; FE stores projectId + line refs

erpEndpointsAlreadyExist: GET /reports/financial/job-cost-matrix (FE expects; implement when cost center on child lines exists)

coverageAudit.summary: v1.0 covered core operational entities. v1.1 adds coverage audit, shared patterns, HR/attendance detail, collaboration, documents, GIS/Gantt, billing placeholders, and registry-only planned modules.

fullyModeled: project-overview → project_stakeholder_groups (generated UI; store as JSON or normalized)
sites-map → site map coords on sites + site_photos
gantt-chart → gantt_schedules, gantt_tasks (currently standalone demo schedule)

job-cost-matrix → ERP report; construction BE must post costCenterId on transactions
erpExcluded: All /erp/* routes — transactions, ledgers, items, godowns, cost centers API already exist

cost_codes.description: Project cost codes — map to ERP cost categories for job mileage rows

projects.description: Master project register — hub for sites, BOQ, issuance, bids, DSR

wbs_tasks.description: Work breakdown tasks under site milestones

boq_line_items.description: Contract BOQ budget lines — source for issuance tags and consumption

material_catalog.description: Construction material master — links to BOQ item and ERP stock item

material_issuances.description: Site material issue vouchers — tagged to project, site, BOQ, cost code

erpTransactionId.note: Stock-out transaction in ERP when posted

boqBudgetQty.note: Snapshot from BOQ at issue time

material_consumption.description: Aggregated BOQ vs actual per project + cost code + BOQ line. Can be view or materialized table.

construction_invoices.description: Construction project billing header — material + service lines; posts to ERP as ConstructionSales

bids.description: Inward (client tenders) and outward (subcontract packages) — discriminator bidDirection

daily_site_reports.description: DSR — daily progress with BOQ quantity reporting

payroll_project_allocations.description: Labour cost split to projects — feeds job mileage labour row

approval_workflows.description: Generic approval engine used across entities

users.description: System users — referenced by audit byUserId fields across all modules

entity_audit_log.description: Polymorphic audit trail — replaces per-entity audit[] arrays in mock data

entity_attachments.description: Polymorphic file attachments for any entity

item_code_catalog.description: BOQ item code master — ITEM_CODE_CATALOG in boq-creation.data.ts

attendance_records.description: HR attendance — hr-attendance.data.ts; feeds payroll and labour cost

project_gis_geometries.description: User-drawn GIS sketches per project — GeoJSON + labels

project_stakeholder_groups.description: Project overview radial diagram — optional JSON blob per project

material_requisitions.description: Site material requests — site-mobile material-requests (not yet built in FE)

plannedEntities.description: Schema stubs for feature-registry pages without FE mock data yet

client_invoices.note: Distinct from construction_invoices ERP bridge — tax invoice from certified IPC

erpPoId.note: Link to ERP purchase order when created

job_cost_matrix.description: Job mileage — spend vs earn by project (cost center) and cost category. Implemented in ERP API; construction BE feeds allocations.
job_cost_matrix.prerequisite: Every ERP child_transaction must carry costCenterId and optional costCategoryId when posted from construction modules

dataSourcesForRows.material-total: Sum ERP expense/inventory lines where cost_code.category = material OR ledger group = purchases/COGS
dataSourcesForRows.labour-total: Sum payroll_project_allocations + subcontract expense ledgers tagged labour
dataSourcesForRows.overhead-total: Sum expense ledgers classified overhead (admin, utilities, etc.)
dataSourcesForRows.expense-ledger: Each P&L expense ledger with amounts split by costCenterId column
dataSourcesForRows.income-ledger: Each P&L income ledger — construction invoices, IPC, certified BOQ billings

boq_vs_actual.note: Planned in feature-registry; not yet in FE

implementationPriority: 6. payroll_project_allocations for labour column in job matrix
10. ERP: costCenterId on child_transactions + job-cost-matrix API
